scientific_integrity: The pre-existing stationary current formula is credited. The new claim is the unique constrained-rate optimum and exact dilute/dense scaling, supported by a self-contained algebraic proof and reproducible tests. No external independent assessment is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Infinite-volume stationary-sector current and externally imposed positive kinetic-rate sum only. Relies on the previously established Gibbs transfer-matrix current; finite-ring relaxation, nonstationary current, and possible previously unindexed rate-allocation theorems are not resolved.
title: Unique fixed-rate-budget transport allocation in the tandem exclusion process
